title: Event
description: Append-only episodic memory event in PostgreSQL

group_id.description: Tenant namespace. Migration 19 enforces strict CHECK: ^allura-[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$

event_type.description: Operation type. No DB-level enum constraint (VARCHAR(100) + non-empty CHECK only) — this enum reflects actual emitted values in src/lib/events/event-types.ts and all call sites.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or user who triggered the event

session_id.description: Session identifier for identity scoping and audit correlation. Added by migration 10 (brooks-tracking). NULL allowed (nullable column).

step_id.description: Optional step identifier within a workflow

parent_event_id.description: FK to events.id for parent-child execution chain linking

runtime.description: Runtime platform: claude-code, copilot, openclaw, opencode. Added by migration 10 (brooks-tracking). Default: 'unknown'.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the event record. Added by migration 17. Default: 1.

status.description: Operation status. DB CHECK constraint (chk_events_valid_status) enforces exactly these four values.

error_message.description: Error description. Populated only on failure.

error_code.description: Error code. Populated only on failure.

created_at.description: Write timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). DEFAULT NOW(). Immutable — append-only invariant.
